Opportunities for foreign Teachers and Staff Università Politecnica delle Marche promotes international mobility initiatives for teaching and training purposes. In this section, you can learn about opportunities for teaching and administrative staff to carry out a period of teaching or training at UNIVPM. Teaching and Staff mobilities for capacity building purposes - ITACA Call for applications for 4 international mobility grants for lecturers and staff from the 10 African universities participating in the project, for capacity building activities. Deadline: 18 march 2026, 12.00 a.m. International mobilities for Lecturers - ITACA Call for applications for 15 international mobility grants for lecturers from the 10 African universities participating in the project for teaching purposes. Deadline: 18 march 2026, 12.00 a.m. Erasmus+ Staff Week The Staff Mobility for Training action of the Erasmus+ Programme represents an important professional training opportunity for staff at higher education institutions. The initiative offers the chance to undertake a short in-person experience at a higher education institution in one of the countries participating in the programme, either through job shadowing in offices similar to those of the participant's own institution, or by attending events organised by other European universities on topics relevant to the participant's work (Staff Week). Visiting Scientist Opportunities for administrative and academic staff to undertake training or teaching periods at UNIVPM. Opportunities for foreign Teachers and Staff Università Politecnica delle Marche promotes international mobility initiatives for teaching and training purposes. In this section, you can learn about opportunities for teaching and administrative staff to carry out a period of teaching or training at UNIVPM. Teaching and Staff mobilities for capacity building purposes - ITACA Call for applications for 4 international mobility grants for lecturers and staff from the 10 African universities participating in the project, for capacity building activities. Deadline: 18 march 2026, 12.00 a.m. International mobilities for Lecturers - ITACA Call for applications for 15 international mobility grants for lecturers from the 10 African universities participating in the project for teaching purposes. Deadline: 18 march 2026, 12.00 a.m. Erasmus+ Staff Week The Staff Mobility for Training action of the Erasmus+ Programme represents an important professional training opportunity for staff at higher education institutions. The initiative offers the chance to undertake a short in-person experience at a higher education institution in one of the countries participating in the programme, either through job shadowing in offices similar to those of the participant's own institution, or by attending events organised by other European universities on topics relevant to the participant's work (Staff Week). Visiting Scientist Opportunities for administrative and academic staff to undertake training or teaching periods at UNIVPM. Double degrees UNIVPM offers to international students the possibility to participate in the Double Degree programmes. The successful completion of the International Master in Marine Biological Resources (IMBRSea) leads to the award of a joint degree. Opportunities for international students International students may enrol in programmes and courses in the field of studies of their interest or participate in international exchange programmes at Università Politecnica delle Marche: Courses in English language Università Politecnica delle Marche offers Master’s Degree courses taught in English language. Scholarships for international students Every year Università Politecnica delle Marche offers scholarship programmes for international students admitted to the Master’s Degree courses entirely taught in English language. At the following link you can see all opportunities for scholarships aimed at enrolling at Università Politecnica delle Marche. Double degrees UNIVPM offers to international students the possibility to participate in the Double Degree programmes. Double degrees are integrated study programmes organized in cooperation with foreign universities and require study periods abroad at the partner university. After the final examination students are awarded an academic degree by each university participating in the programme. Erasmus Mundus Joint Master Degree (IMBRSea) UNIVPM participates to the International Master in Marine Biological Resources (IMBRSea), an Erasmus Mundus Joint Master Degree programme organized by nine leading European universities in the field of marine sciences. An Erasmus Mundus Joint Master Degrees is a high-level integrated international study programme delivered by an international consortium of Universities from different countries. The successful completion of the International Master in Marine Biological Resources (IMBRSea) leads to the award of a joint degree. Registrar's Office The Registrar’s Office deals with the administrative management of students’ academic careers during their time at university, from enrolment to graduation, for bachelor’s and master’s degree courses. It also manages procedures related to state examinations. Students at the Università Politecnica delle Marche can access the following on line services by logging onto their Personal Esse3web Area : Consult academic career Change personal information (address, telephone details and email) Present study plan Register for exams Give consent for the retrieval of ISEE (Equivalent Economic Status Indicator) documents from the INPS database Consult university tuition fee instalments and pay through the PagoPA platform Access university e-mail. The institutional university e-mail address is used for official university communications. Download the declaration forms regarding your university career. Registrar's Office The Registrar’s Office deals with the administrative management of students’ academic careers during their time at university, from enrolment to graduation, for bachelor’s and master’s degree courses. It also manages procedures related to state examinations. Students at the Università Politecnica delle Marche can access the following on line services by logging onto their Personal Esse3web Area : Consult academic career Change personal information (address, telephone details and email) Present study plan Register for exams Give consent for the retrieval of ISEE (Equivalent Economic Status Indicator) documents from the INPS database Consult university tuition fee instalments and pay through the PagoPA platform Access university e-mail. The institutional university e-mail address is used for official university communications. Download the declaration forms regarding your university career. Mobility for study Università Politecnica delle Marche offers students many opportunities to spend a study period abroad within different mobility programmes: ITACA Project 'Internationalising ITalian Academia with Africa' - Research fo Thesis Call for applications for 5 international mobility grants for students going to the 10 African universities participating in the project, for capacity thesis research. Deadline: 18 march 2026, 12.00 a.m Erasmus+ The Erasmus+ Programme provides students with the opportunity to spend a study period abroad at a partner university in one of the participating countries that has signed an inter-institutional agreement with Università Politecnica delle Marche. New Call - Deadline: 04 March 2025 Consortium Erasmus+ UNIADRION Italy Officially inaugurated in 2020 the Erasmus+ 'Uniadrion Italy' Consortium brings together 11 Italian Universities and aims at connecting the institutions, academic communities and societies of Albania, Bosnia-Herzegovina, Italy, North Macedonia, Croatia, Greece, Montenegro, Serbia and Slovenia through the mobility of individuals and joint dissemination projects. The Consortium offers various mobility opportunities abroad, for studies as well as for internships. Check available calls ANC_HIO Mobility programme for students exchange with the Ohio College of Business reserved to students enrolled in the Master's Degree courses of the Faculty of Economics. Double Degree Programmes UNIVPM offers to international students the possibility to participate in the Double Degree programmes. Double degrees are integrated study programmes organized in cooperation with foreign universities and require study periods abroad at the partner university. After the final examination students are awarded an academic degree by each university participating in the programme. New Call - Deadline: 04 March 2025 Consortium Erasmus+ UNIADRION Italy Officially inaugurated in 2020 the Erasmus+ 'Uniadrion Italy' Consortium brings together 11 Italian Universities and aims at connecting the institutions, academic communities and societies of Albania, Bosnia-Herzegovina, Italy, North Macedonia, Croatia, Greece, Montenegro, Serbia and Slovenia through the mobility of individuals and joint dissemination projects. The Consortium offers various mobility opportunities abroad, for studies as well as for internships. Check available calls ANC_HIO Mobility programme for students exchange with the Ohio College of Business reserved to students enrolled in the Master's Degree courses of the Faculty of Economics. Double Degree Programmes UNIVPM offers to international students the possibility to participate in the Double Degree programmes. Double degrees are integrated study programmes organized in cooperation with foreign universities and require study periods abroad at the partner university. After the final examination students are awarded an academic degree by each university participating in the programme. Apply for accommodation in the ERSU student houses or in the university flats, and pay the registration fee ASAP. Further information and the application form is available at www.univpm.it Book a place in the youth hostel if required. Get the necessary insurance, especially health care. EU citizens : remember to get the Health Card from your local social security office. Check if you need a visa. Bring your passport or Identity Card with you. Check the website about the Italian language courses and contact the CSAL ( The University Language Centre ), for further information you might need to apply. If you have any questions on practical matters, you may contact us at the International Mobility Office ( international.mobility@univpm.it ). After arrival in Ancona and while here For ERASMUS students : register at the International Mobility Office (c/o Ripartizione Relazioni con il territorio), Piazza Roma, 22, 60100 Ancona, Italy. You have to bring 1 passport photo and your ID or passport with you. Execute the contract for accommodation in the student house or in the university flats and pick the key up. For ERASMUS students: apply for student card (Libretto Universitario) at the International Mobility Office (c/o Ripartizione Relazioni con il territorio). Contact your professor and course lecturers if necessary. Get a bus pass from the Conerbus office, in Corso Mazzini if you need one. Get an Italian mobile connection. It's cheaper! Be active and participate. There are a lot of happening organized for International and Italian students...also all ideas for new happenings are welcome! Before leaving Italy Return the key of your flat to ERSU. For ERASMUS students: return your student card (Libretto Universitario) to the International Mobility Office and confirm the date of your departure. For ERASMUS students: ask the International Mobility Office for a transcript of your examinations and for a declaration about your study period at UNIVPM. Mobility for study Università Politecnica delle Marche offers students many opportunities to spend a study period abroad within different mobility programmes: ITACA Project 'Internationalising ITalian Academia with Africa' - Research fo Thesis Call for applications for 5 international mobility grants for students going to the 10 African universities participating in the project, for capacity thesis research. Deadline: 18 march 2026, 12.00 a.m Erasmus+ The Erasmus+ Programme provides students with the opportunity to spend a study period abroad at a partner university in one of the participating countries that has signed an inter-institutional agreement with Università Politecnica delle Marche. New Call - Deadline: 04 March 2025 Consortium Erasmus+ UNIADRION Italy Officially inaugurated in 2020 the Erasmus+ 'Uniadrion Italy' Consortium brings together 11 Italian Universities and aims at connecting the institutions, academic communities and societies of Albania, Bosnia-Herzegovina, Italy, North Macedonia, Croatia, Greece, Montenegro, Serbia and Slovenia through the mobility of individuals and joint dissemination projects. The Consortium offers various mobility opportunities abroad, for studies as well as for internships. Check available calls ANC_HIO Mobility programme for students exchange with the Ohio College of Business reserved to students enrolled in the Master's Degree courses of the Faculty of Economics. Double Degree Programmes UNIVPM offers to international students the possibility to participate in the Double Degree programmes. Double degrees are integrated study programmes organized in cooperation with foreign universities and require study periods abroad at the partner university. After the final examination students are awarded an academic degree by each university participating in the programme. Opportunities for international students International students may enrol in programmes and courses in the field of studies of their interest or participate in international exchange programmes at Università Politecnica delle Marche: Courses in English language Università Politecnica delle Marche offers Master’s Degree courses taught in English language. Scholarships for international students Every year Università Politecnica delle Marche offers scholarship programmes for international students admitted to the Master’s Degree courses entirely taught in English language. At the following link you can see all opportunities for scholarships aimed at enrolling at Università Politecnica delle Marche. Double degrees UNIVPM offers to international students the possibility to participate in the Double Degree programmes. Double degrees are integrated study programmes organized in cooperation with foreign universities and require study periods abroad at the partner university. After the final examination students are awarded an academic degree by each university participating in the programme. Erasmus Mundus Joint Master Degree (IMBRSea) UNIVPM participates to the International Master in Marine Biological Resources (IMBRSea), an Erasmus Mundus Joint Master Degree programme organized by nine leading European universities in the field of marine sciences. An Erasmus Mundus Joint Master Degrees is a high-level integrated international study programme delivered by an international consortium of Universities from different countries. The successful completion of the International Master in Marine Biological Resources (IMBRSea) leads to the award of a joint degree. Opportunities for international students International students may enrol in programmes and courses in the field of studies of their interest or participate in international exchange programmes at Università Politecnica delle Marche: Courses in English language Università Politecnica delle Marche offers Master’s Degree courses taught in English language. Scholarships for international students Every year Università Politecnica delle Marche offers scholarship programmes for international students admitted to the Master’s Degree courses entirely taught in English language. At the following link you can see all opportunities for scholarships aimed at enrolling at Università Politecnica delle Marche. Double degrees UNIVPM offers to international students the possibility to participate in the Double Degree programmes. Double degrees are integrated study programmes organized in cooperation with foreign universities and require study periods abroad at the partner university. After the final examination students are awarded an academic degree by each university participating in the programme. Erasmus Mundus Joint Master Degree (IMBRSea) UNIVPM participates to the International Master in Marine Biological Resources (IMBRSea), an Erasmus Mundus Joint Master Degree programme organized by nine leading European universities in the field of marine sciences. An Erasmus Mundus Joint Master Degrees is a high-level integrated international study programme delivered by an international consortium of Universities from different countries. The successful completion of the International Master in Marine Biological Resources (IMBRSea) leads to the award of a joint degree. Opportunities for international students International students may enrol in programmes and courses in the field of studies of their interest or participate in international exchange programmes at Università Politecnica delle Marche: Courses in English language Università Politecnica delle Marche offers Master’s Degree courses taught in English language. Scholarships for international students Every year Università Politecnica delle Marche offers scholarship programmes for international students admitted to the Master’s Degree courses entirely taught in English language. At the following link you can see all opportunities for scholarships aimed at enrolling at Università Politecnica delle Marche. Double degrees UNIVPM offers to international students the possibility to participate in the Double Degree programmes. Double degrees are integrated study programmes organized in cooperation with foreign universities and require study periods abroad at the partner university. After the final examination students are awarded an academic degree by each university participating in the programme. Erasmus Mundus Joint Master Degree (IMBRSea) UNIVPM participates to the International Master in Marine Biological Resources (IMBRSea), an Erasmus Mundus Joint Master Degree programme organized by nine leading European universities in the field of marine sciences. An Erasmus Mundus Joint Master Degrees is a high-level integrated international study programme delivered by an international consortium of Universities from different countries. The successful completion of the International Master in Marine Biological Resources (IMBRSea) leads to the award of a joint degree. Internships abroad Università Politecnica delle Marche offers students and recent-graduates many opportunities to perform internships abroad: Erasmus+ Traineeship and CampusWorld Discover the opportunities for students, PhD students and recent graduates to carry out an internship abroad through our mobility programmes. The new Erasmus+ Traineeship and CampusWorld Call June 2025 -July 2026 has been published. Application deadline: 16 April 2026 12.00 am. Consortium Erasmus+ UNIADRION Italy Officially inaugurated in 2020 the Erasmus+ 'Uniadrion Italy' Consortium brings together 11 Italian Universities and aims at connecting the institutions, academic communities and societies of Albania, Bosnia-Herzegovina, Italy, North Macedonia, Croatia, Greece, Montenegro, Serbia and Slovenia through the mobility of individuals and joint dissemination projects. The Consortium offers various mobility opportunities abroad, for studies as well as for internships. Application deadline: 15 May 2026 12.00 am. Check here the open calls Internships abroad Erasmus+ TUCEP Consortium The selection call, promoted by the TUCEP Consortium , is aimed at awarding scholarships for the completion of an internship abroad lasting a minimum of 2 months (60 days). Check available calls Further instructions and documents TUCEP (198 KB) Internships abroad Consortium Erasmus+ SEND The selection call, promoted by the SEND Mobility Consortium , is aimed at awarding scholarships for the completion of an internship abroad lasting a minimum of 2 months (60 days). Check available calls Further instructions and documents Internships abroad Erasmus+ EU4EU EuGen Consortium The selection call, promoted by the EU4EU EuGen Consortium , is aimed at awarding scholarships for the completion of an internship abroad lasting a minimum of 2 months (60 days). Check available calls Further instructions and documents INFODAY NEW CALL Tuesday, October 14 at 2:00 PM , online via Zoom. To participate, complete this registration form by Sunday, October 13 at 8:00 PM . Progetto Global Consulting Program (GCP) The Global Consulting Program is an internship organized by the Faculty of Economics in collaboration with ISTAO. Application deadline on 12 th April 2026, 11.00 pm. Competitividad Global para PyMES (CGPyMES) programme The Competitividad Global para PyMES programme is an internship organized in cooperation between the Faculty of Economics and the Universidad Nacional del Litoral, Santa Fé, Argentina. Application deadline on 12 th April 2026, 11.00 pm. Consortium Erasmus+ UNIADRION Italy Officially inaugurated in 2020 the Erasmus+ 'Uniadrion Italy' Consortium brings together 11 Italian Universities and aims at connecting the institutions, academic communities and societies of Albania, Bosnia-Herzegovina, Italy, North Macedonia, Croatia, Greece, Montenegro, Serbia and Slovenia through the mobility of individuals and joint dissemination projects. The Consortium offers various mobility opportunities abroad, for studies as well as for internships. Application deadline: 15 May 2026 12.00 am. Application deadline on 12 th April 2026, 11.00 pm. The Consortium offers various mobility opportunities abroad for teaching and training. Deadline: 5 March 2023 Erasmus+ Call for Staff Training abroad - SEND Consortium Marche Polytechnic University is participating in the Erasmus+ project coordinated by the SEND Mobility Consortium . The call, aimed at both teaching and non-teaching staff of the universities affiliated with the Consortium, funds training periods abroad . Check available calls Erasmus+ Call for Staff Teaching and Training mobilities abroad - TUCEP Consortium Marche Polytechnic University is participating in the Erasmus+ project coordinated by the TUCEP Consortium . The call, aimed at both teaching and non-teaching staff of the universities affiliated with the Consortium, funds teaching and training periods abroad . Check available calls Erasmus+ call for administrative staff This Call aims to assign 5 grants to administrative staff at UNIVPM to perform an international mobility experience within the Erasmus+ Programme "Staff mobility for training (STT)" action. Call expired on 31 st January 2020 Erasmus+ Call for Staff Training abroad EU4EU EuGen Consortium Marche Polytechnic University is participating in the Erasmus+ project coordinated by the EU4EU Consortium . The call, aimed at non-teaching staff of the universities affiliated with the Consortium, funds training periods abroad . Disability and Specific Learning Disorders The University has activated a service dedicated to the assistance and inclusion of students with disabilities and/or Specific Learning Disorders (“DSA”), in order to support them. Students, at the time of enrollment or renewal of enrollment, are invited to report their situation to the relevant Student Office, by presenting the appropriate certification (disability or learning disorders diagnostic certification, no older than three years, if produced before the age of 18). In case of certification for other kind of Special Educational Needs (“BES”), it is necessary to carry out the same bureaucratic process. Every situation will be carefully evaluated. The staff of “Ufficio Studenti e Diritto allo Studio” (Via Oberdan 8, Ancona) is available for information and clarification. Students interested can also directly contact the psychologists at “Info Point Disabilità / DSA”. Guidelines for students Guidelines for teachers Services Tax exemption and reduction Psychological support Guidance in the university pathway Hub maps Tutor guide Italian laws The SensusAcces service is available for the students and for all the Università Politecnica delle Marche’s institutional users. Click here to use the service The SensusAccess is a self service utility, made for academic ististutions, that offers the possibility to automatically convert documents and web pages in alternative, accessible and multimedia format: audiobooks in MP3 and Daisy format, e-books in EPUB, EPUB3 and digital Braille format. This service can be used to convert inaccessible documents as well, such as image files in PDF, JPG format and Microsoft PowerPoint presentations in more accessible and easier formats. Disability and Specific Learning Disorders The University has activated a service dedicated to the assistance and inclusion of students with disabilities and/or Specific Learning Disorders (“DSA”), in order to support them. Students, at the time of enrollment or renewal of enrollment, are invited to report their situation to the relevant Student Office, by presenting the appropriate certification (disability or learning disorders diagnostic certification, no older than three years, if produced before the age of 18). In case of certification for other kind of Special Educational Needs (“BES”), it is necessary to carry out the same bureaucratic process. Every situation will be carefully evaluated. The staff of “Ufficio Studenti e Diritto allo Studio” (Via Oberdan 8, Ancona) is available for information and clarification. Students interested can also directly contact the psychologists at “Info Point Disabilità / DSA”. Guidelines for students Guidelines for teachers Services Tax exemption and reduction Psychological support Guidance in the university pathway Hub maps Tutor guide Italian laws The SensusAcces service is available for the students and for all the Università Politecnica delle Marche’s institutional users. Click here to use the service The SensusAccess is a self service utility, made for academic ististutions, that offers the possibility to automatically convert documents and web pages in alternative, accessible and multimedia format: audiobooks in MP3 and Daisy format, e-books in EPUB, EPUB3 and digital Braille format. This service can be used to convert inaccessible documents as well, such as image files in PDF, JPG format and Microsoft PowerPoint presentations in more accessible and easier formats. Disability and Specific Learning Disorders The University has activated a service dedicated to the assistance and inclusion of students with disabilities and/or Specific Learning Disorders (“DSA”), in order to support them. Students, at the time of enrollment or renewal of enrollment, are invited to report their situation to the relevant Student Office, by presenting the appropriate certification (disability or learning disorders diagnostic certification, no older than three years, if produced before the age of 18). In case of certification for other kind of Special Educational Needs (“BES”), it is necessary to carry out the same bureaucratic process. Every situation will be carefully evaluated. The staff of “Ufficio Studenti e Diritto allo Studio” (Via Oberdan 8, Ancona) is available for information and clarification. Students interested can also directly contact the psychologists at “Info Point Disabilità / DSA”. Guidelines for students Guidelines for teachers Services Tax exemption and reduction Psychological support Guidance in the university pathway Hub maps Tutor guide Italian laws The SensusAcces service is available for the students and for all the Università Politecnica delle Marche’s institutional users. Click here to use the service The SensusAccess is a self service utility, made for academic ististutions, that offers the possibility to automatically convert documents and web pages in alternative, accessible and multimedia format: audiobooks in MP3 and Daisy format, e-books in EPUB, EPUB3 and digital Braille format. This service can be used to convert inaccessible documents as well, such as image files in PDF, JPG format and Microsoft PowerPoint presentations in more accessible and easier formats. Disability and Specific Learning Disorders The University has activated a service dedicated to the assistance and inclusion of students with disabilities and/or Specific Learning Disorders (“DSA”), in order to support them. Students, at the time of enrollment or renewal of enrollment, are invited to report their situation to the relevant Student Office, by presenting the appropriate certification (disability or learning disorders diagnostic certification, no older than three years, if produced before the age of 18). In case of certification for other kind of Special Educational Needs (“BES”), it is necessary to carry out the same bureaucratic process. Every situation will be carefully evaluated. The staff of “Ufficio Studenti e Diritto allo Studio” (Via Oberdan 8, Ancona) is available for information and clarification. Students interested can also directly contact the psychologists at “Info Point Disabilità / DSA”. Disability and Specific Learning Disorders The University has activated a service dedicated to the assistance and inclusion of students with disabilities and/or Specific Learning Disorders (“DSA”), in order to support them. Students, at the time of enrollment or renewal of enrollment, are invited to report their situation to the relevant Student Office, by presenting the appropriate certification (disability or learning disorders diagnostic certification, no older than three years, if produced before the age of 18). In case of certification for other kind of Special Educational Needs (“BES”), it is necessary to carry out the same bureaucratic process. Every situation will be carefully evaluated. The staff of “Ufficio Studenti e Diritto allo Studio” (Via Oberdan 8, Ancona) is available for information and clarification. Students interested can also directly contact the psychologists at “Info Point Disabilità / DSA”. Guidelines for students Guidelines for teachers Services Tax exemption and reduction Psychological support Guidance in the university pathway Hub maps Tutor guide Italian laws The SensusAcces service is available for the students and for all the Università Politecnica delle Marche’s institutional users. Click here to use the service The SensusAccess is a self service utility, made for academic ististutions, that offers the possibility to automatically convert documents and web pages in alternative, accessible and multimedia format: audiobooks in MP3 and Daisy format, e-books in EPUB, EPUB3 and digital Braille format. This service can be used to convert inaccessible documents as well, such as image files in PDF, JPG format and Microsoft PowerPoint presentations in more accessible and easier formats. Job Placement Job Placement accompanies students and graduates towards the world of work, creating a direct bridge between companies and institutions and the university world. It communicates opportunities to graduates, who will be able to use the skills developed during their studies by reconciling them with the needs of the labour market, and constantly communicates with companies and institutions to present employment opportunities they make available. Thanks to this passage of direct information, supply and demand will be matched more quickly. To ease this meeting, Job Placement provides: an IT platform (Almalaurea) for matching labour supply and demand; career coaching activities and job orientation seminars aimed at students and graduates of the University; Job Service Day (Career Day) and company presentations; coordination of activities related to Internships (curricular, non-curricular and incoming) in collaboration with the Teaching Structures/Faculties, and advice on active labour policy measures. STUDENTS & GRADUATES POST YOUR CV AND CONSULT THE JOB VACANCIES BOARD COMPANIES CV SEARCH AND JOB POSTING Companies have the opportunity to identify the most suitable profiles. JOB VACANCIES BOARD Get in touch with Companies and CONSULT JOB OFFERS COMPANY PROFILE You can consult the company pages, send your application directly and stay up-to-date. Business presentations Find out about the job opportunities offered by companies and get to know the business contacts personally by submitting your application! Job Placement Job Placement accompanies students and graduates towards the world of work, creating a direct bridge between companies and institutions and the university world. It communicates opportunities to graduates, who will be able to use the skills developed during their studies by reconciling them with the needs of the labour market, and constantly communicates with companies and institutions to present employment opportunities they make available. Thanks to this passage of direct information, supply and demand will be matched more quickly. To ease this meeting, Job Placement provides: an IT platform (Almalaurea) for matching labour supply and demand; career coaching activities and job orientation seminars aimed at students and graduates of the University; Job Service Day (Career Day) and company presentations; coordination of activities related to Internships (curricular, non-curricular and incoming) in collaboration with the Teaching Structures/Faculties, and advice on active labour policy measures. Job Placement Job Placement accompanies students and graduates towards the world of work, creating a direct bridge between companies and institutions and the university world. It communicates opportunities to graduates, who will be able to use the skills developed during their studies by reconciling them with the needs of the labour market, and constantly communicates with companies and institutions to present employment opportunities they make available. Thanks to this passage of direct information, supply and demand will be matched more quickly. To ease this meeting, Job Placement provides: an IT platform (Almalaurea) for matching labour supply and demand; career coaching activities and job orientation seminars aimed at students and graduates of the University; Job Service Day (Career Day) and company presentations; coordination of activities related to Internships (curricular, non-curricular and incoming) in collaboration with the Teaching Structures/Faculties, and advice on active labour policy measures. This orientation service wants to help you decide, think about your interests, expectations, potentiality, and make the best choice for your future. This service is opened to high school graduated students that want to continue their studies, graduated students that want to follow a master, a PhD or enter the labour market. Opportunities for foreign Teachers and Staff Università Politecnica delle Marche promotes international mobility initiatives for teaching and training purposes. In this section, you can learn about opportunities for teaching and administrative staff to carry out a period of teaching or training at UNIVPM. Teaching and Staff mobilities for capacity building purposes - ITACA Call for applications for 4 international mobility grants for lecturers and staff from the 10 African universities participating in the project, for capacity building activities. Deadline: 18 march 2026, 12.00 a.m. International mobilities for Lecturers - ITACA Call for applications for 15 international mobility grants for lecturers from the 10 African universities participating in the project for teaching purposes. Deadline: 18 march 2026, 12.00 a.m. Erasmus+ Staff Week The Staff Mobility for Training action of the Erasmus+ Programme represents an important professional training opportunity for staff at higher education institutions. The initiative offers the chance to undertake a short in-person experience at a higher education institution in one of the countries participating in the programme, either through job shadowing in offices similar to those of the participant's own institution, or by attending events organised by other European universities on topics relevant to the participant's work (Staff Week). Visiting Scientist Opportunities for administrative and academic staff to undertake training or teaching periods at UNIVPM. Opportunities for foreign Teachers and Staff Università Politecnica delle Marche promotes international mobility initiatives for teaching and training purposes. In this section, you can learn about opportunities for teaching and administrative staff to carry out a period of teaching or training at UNIVPM. Teaching and Staff mobilities for capacity building purposes - ITACA Call for applications for 4 international mobility grants for lecturers and staff from the 10 African universities participating in the project, for capacity building activities. Deadline: 18 march 2026, 12.00 a.m. International mobilities for Lecturers - ITACA Call for applications for 15 international mobility grants for lecturers from the 10 African universities participating in the project for teaching purposes. Deadline: 18 march 2026, 12.00 a.m. Erasmus+ Staff Week The Staff Mobility for Training action of the Erasmus+ Programme represents an important professional training opportunity for staff at higher education institutions. The initiative offers the chance to undertake a short in-person experience at a higher education institution in one of the countries participating in the programme, either through job shadowing in offices similar to those of the participant's own institution, or by attending events organised by other European universities on topics relevant to the participant's work (Staff Week). Visiting Scientist Opportunities for administrative and academic staff to undertake training or teaching periods at UNIVPM. Opportunities for foreign Teachers and Staff Università Politecnica delle Marche promotes international mobility initiatives for teaching and training purposes. In this section, you can learn about opportunities for teaching and administrative staff to carry out a period of teaching or training at UNIVPM. Teaching and Staff mobilities for capacity building purposes - ITACA Call for applications for 4 international mobility grants for lecturers and staff from the 10 African universities participating in the project, for capacity building activities. Deadline: 18 march 2026, 12.00 a.m. International mobilities for Lecturers - ITACA Call for applications for 15 international mobility grants for lecturers from the 10 African universities participating in the project for teaching purposes. Deadline: 18 march 2026, 12.00 a.m. Erasmus+ Staff Week The Staff Mobility for Training action of the Erasmus+ Programme represents an important professional training opportunity for staff at higher education institutions. The initiative offers the chance to undertake a short in-person experience at a higher education institution in one of the countries participating in the programme, either through job shadowing in offices similar to those of the participant's own institution, or by attending events organised by other European universities on topics relevant to the participant's work (Staff Week). Visiting Scientist Opportunities for administrative and academic staff to undertake training or teaching periods at UNIVPM. INVEST IN RESEARCH, INVEST IN THE FUTURE Give your ‘5 per 1000’ Italian tax donation to UNIVPM Why choose to allocate your 5 per 1000 to the Università Politecnica delle Marche? Never before has the value of academic research been so clearly understood as it is at this moment. The contribution of each individual, along with new resources, is essential to enhance and strengthen the attentive and passionate work of young researchers at the service of the community. The Università Politecnica delle Marche takes pride in their results in research: among the 180 Departments of Excellence identified between 2018-2022, 5 Departments of the Università Politecnica delle Marche were funded, two of which have also been reconfirmed Departments of Excellence for the period from 2023-2027. The strategy is to increase, on one hand, the awareness and training of our researchers and, on the other hand, to also encourage the various academic areas of our University to collaborate, developing a multidisciplinary approach necessary for effective participation in the new Horizon Europe programme (2021-2027). Our University is featured in the main International Rankings and since 2021 has been classified in the QS World University ranking, which particularly assesses the quality of research and international reputation. A significant improvement can be seen in the UI GreenMetric, aimed at verifying the commitment and policies that universities adopt regarding sustainability. It is also thanks to your support that our University and our researchers have achieved these important milestones! Thanks to your contribution, Univpm continues to be among the top public universities in Italy, in terms of the amount of student contributions assigned with the 5 per 1000. Giving strength to research with the 5 per 1000 costs nothing and is not an alternative choice to the 8 per 1000. What should I do? When filing our tax declaration, we can all decide how to allocate this portion of the taxes paid to the State. Allocating 5 per 1000 is simple: just sign in the box “Funding for Academic Research and the University” on the tax declaration, indicating the Italian tax code (Codice Fiscale) of the Università Politecnica delle Marche. 00382520427 How are the funds used? Our University will continue to use the funds raised from the 5 per 1000 to support research and, above all, the young people studying and working at the university, by allocating resources to a dedicated fund named after Carlo Urbani, a doctor who graduated from our university and contributed, through his research and commitment, to discovering and containing the SARS epidemic. Amount and allocation of the contributions received Allocating 5 per 1000 to UNIVPM means believing in young people and their future. INVEST IN RESEARCH, INVEST IN THE FUTURE Give your ‘5 per 1000’ Italian tax donation to UNIVPM Why choose to allocate your 5 per 1000 to the Università Politecnica delle Marche? Never before has the value of academic research been so clearly understood as it is at this moment. The contribution of each individual, along with new resources, is essential to enhance and strengthen the attentive and passionate work of young researchers at the service of the community. The Università Politecnica delle Marche takes pride in their results in research: among the 180 Departments of Excellence identified between 2018-2022, 5 Departments of the Università Politecnica delle Marche were funded, two of which have also been reconfirmed Departments of Excellence for the period from 2023-2027. The strategy is to increase, on one hand, the awareness and training of our researchers and, on the other hand, to also encourage the various academic areas of our University to collaborate, developing a multidisciplinary approach necessary for effective participation in the new Horizon Europe programme (2021-2027). Our University is featured in the main International Rankings and since 2021 has been classified in the QS World University ranking, which particularly assesses the quality of research and international reputation. A significant improvement can be seen in the UI GreenMetric, aimed at verifying the commitment and policies that universities adopt regarding sustainability. It is also thanks to your support that our University and our researchers have achieved these important milestones! Thanks to your contribution, Univpm continues to be among the top public universities in Italy, in terms of the amount of student contributions assigned with the 5 per 1000. Giving strength to research with the 5 per 1000 costs nothing and is not an alternative choice to the 8 per 1000. What should I do? When filing our tax declaration, we can all decide how to allocate this portion of the taxes paid to the State. Allocating 5 per 1000 is simple: just sign in the box “Funding for Academic Research and the University” on the tax declaration, indicating the Italian tax code (Codice Fiscale) of the Università Politecnica delle Marche. 00382520427 How are the funds used? Our University will continue to use the funds raised from the 5 per 1000 to support research and, above all, the young people studying and working at the university, by allocating resources to a dedicated fund named after Carlo Urbani, a doctor who graduated from our university and contributed, through his research and commitment, to discovering and containing the SARS epidemic. Amount and allocation of the contributions received Allocating 5 per 1000 to UNIVPM means believing in young people and their future. INVEST IN RESEARCH, INVEST IN THE FUTURE Give your ‘5 per 1000’ Italian tax donation to UNIVPM Why choose to allocate your 5 per 1000 to the Università Politecnica delle Marche? Never before has the value of academic research been so clearly understood as it is at this moment. The contribution of each individual, along with new resources, is essential to enhance and strengthen the attentive and passionate work of young researchers at the service of the community. The Università Politecnica delle Marche takes pride in their results in research: among the 180 Departments of Excellence identified between 2018-2022, 5 Departments of the Università Politecnica delle Marche were funded, two of which have also been reconfirmed Departments of Excellence for the period from 2023-2027. The strategy is to increase, on one hand, the awareness and training of our researchers and, on the other hand, to also encourage the various academic areas of our University to collaborate, developing a multidisciplinary approach necessary for effective participation in the new Horizon Europe programme (2021-2027). Our University is featured in the main International Rankings and since 2021 has been classified in the QS World University ranking, which particularly assesses the quality of research and international reputation. A significant improvement can be seen in the UI GreenMetric, aimed at verifying the commitment and policies that universities adopt regarding sustainability. It is also thanks to your support that our University and our researchers have achieved these important milestones! Thanks to your contribution, Univpm continues to be among the top public universities in Italy, in terms of the amount of student contributions assigned with the 5 per 1000. Giving strength to research with the 5 per 1000 costs nothing and is not an alternative choice to the 8 per 1000. What should I do? When filing our tax declaration, we can all decide how to allocate this portion of the taxes paid to the State. Allocating 5 per 1000 is simple: just sign in the box “Funding for Academic Research and the University” on the tax declaration, indicating the Italian tax code (Codice Fiscale) of the Università Politecnica delle Marche. 00382520427 How are the funds used? Our University will continue to use the funds raised from the 5 per 1000 to support research and, above all, the young people studying and working at the university, by allocating resources to a dedicated fund named after Carlo Urbani, a doctor who graduated from our university and contributed, through his research and commitment, to discovering and containing the SARS epidemic. Amount and allocation of the contributions received Allocating 5 per 1000 to UNIVPM means believing in young people and their future. Guida al portale Univpm Informazioni sulla navigazione del portale di Ateneo La guida al portale dell’ UNIVPM è stata realizzata per fornire agli utenti le indicazioni per reperire con più facilità le informazioni e i servizi presenti sul sito. Il sito è gestito con un CMS che garantisce la rispondenza ai requisiti richiesti dalla Legge Stanca 4/2004. Il portale è di tipo responsive e permette la navigazione da qualsiasi tipo di dispositivo. Home Page L'home page di univpm.it è stata progettata con un'interfaccia grafica semplice e intuitiva che ti aiuta nella facile reperibilità dei contenuti del portale di Ateneo. La struttura grafica si compone dei seguenti elementi: Barra dei servizi: blocco visibile nella parte alta del sito che rimane sempre diponibile Rubrica : pagina che permette di trovare i recapiti degli appartenenti al Personale d’Ateneo o alle Associazioni Studentesche; IntestazioneArea Riservata : contenente informazioni e servizi online personalizzati per studenti, docenti, personale tecnico-amministrativo; Esse3web : link di accesso alla piattaforma in cui ogni studente può gestire la propria carriera universitaria; @mail : breve guida per l'utilizzo della email istituzionale; Mappa del sito : pagina in cui esplodono e vengono proposti in modo analitico tutti i contenuti del portale di Ateneo; A-Z : pagina che permette di cercare i contenuti di principale interesse presenti nel sito, elencati in ordine alfabetico, esplosi su due livelli; versioni in lingua: cliccando sulla sigla di interesse si può accedere alle versioni inglese, francese, tedesca e cinese del sito; motore di ricerca per trovare velocemente all’interno del sito l’informazione di nostro interesse inserendo una parola chiave. Il portale è di tipo responsive e permette la navigazione da qualsiasi tipo di dispositivo. Guida al portale Univpm Informazioni sulla navigazione del portale di Ateneo La guida al portale dell’ UNIVPM è stata realizzata per fornire agli utenti le indicazioni per reperire con più facilità le informazioni e i servizi presenti sul sito. Il sito è gestito con un CMS che garantisce la rispondenza ai requisiti richiesti dalla Legge Stanca 4/2004. Il portale è di tipo responsive e permette la navigazione da qualsiasi tipo di dispositivo. Home Page L'home page di univpm.it è stata progettata con un'interfaccia grafica semplice e intuitiva che ti aiuta nella facile reperibilità dei contenuti del portale di Ateneo. La struttura grafica si compone dei seguenti elementi: Barra dei servizi: blocco visibile nella parte alta del sito che rimane sempre diponibile Rubrica : pagina che permette di trovare i recapiti degli appartenenti al Personale d’Ateneo o alle Associazioni Studentesche; IntestazioneArea Riservata : contenente informazioni e servizi online personalizzati per studenti, docenti, personale tecnico-amministrativo; Esse3web : link di accesso alla piattaforma in cui ogni studente può gestire la propria carriera universitaria; @mail : breve guida per l'utilizzo della email istituzionale; Mappa del sito : pagina in cui esplodono e vengono proposti in modo analitico tutti i contenuti del portale di Ateneo; A-Z : pagina che permette di cercare i contenuti di principale interesse presenti nel sito, elencati in ordine alfabetico, esplosi su due livelli; versioni in lingua: cliccando sulla sigla di interesse si può accedere alle versioni inglese, francese, tedesca e cinese del sito; motore di ricerca per trovare velocemente all’interno del sito l’informazione di nostro interesse inserendo una parola chiave. Intestazione: Più usati : un menu per accedere direttamente ai contenuti di frequente consultazione sopratutto per agevolare gli studenti; Logo : logo header che rimanda alla home; Facoltà : Accesso dirtto ai siti delle Facoltà /Dipartimenti; Testata grafica: logo e banner; Menù principale: Ateneo | Didattica | Servizi agli Studenti | Docenti | Ricerca | Internazionale | Percorsi Slider: sezione in cui vengono fatte scorrere le informazioni di rilievo dell'Ateneo. Footer: link sull'Accessibilità, Certificazioni, Utility e Contatti utili e nella parte finale l'indirizzo, e i recapiti ufficiali, oltre all'Informativa sulla Privacy, il collegamento alla PEC e l'Identità di Ateneo. Nel dettaglio, la struttura della Home page: Più usati Menù a scomparsa in cui vengono elencati i link più visitati, che rimandano a pagine di interesse sia per gli studenti che per ogni altro visitatore del sito. Parte Centrale Viene suddivisa in tre sezioni. La prima sezione, Primo piano , è suddivisa in tre blocchi in cui sono evidenziati i congressi e gli eventi istituzionali di rilievo, oltre ad essere canalizzati i bandi e le informazioni indirizzate agli studenti. Sulla destra della prima sezione vengono descritti tutti gli eventi che riguardano l'Ateneo, ordinati per data di scadenza. Nella seconda sezione, Studia e lavora in UnivPM , sono presenti quattro blocchi in cui vengono date informazioni non solo riguardo all'iscrizone ai corsi di laurea attivi, ma anche su come continuare il proprio percorso post lauream. La terza sezione, Magazione Online , presenta tutti i comunicati stampa ufficiali dell'Ateneo. Nel dettaglio, la struttura del resto del sito: Menù di navigazione che si contestualizza a seconda dell'area cliccata nel menù principale Parte centrale che restituisce il dettaglio dell'informazione scelta: può essere un testo oppure una pagina organizzata in link ad ulteriori dettagli. in aggiornamento Follow us Download App 5 x 1000 Last update: 12-06-2018 Torna in cima Torna al corpo Disclaimer UnivPM guarantees equality and equal opportunities for all people in study, research and work. HR Excellence in Research On 11 January 2023, the Università Politecnica delle Marche launched the HRS4R - Human Resources Strategy for Researchers - process required by the European Commission, with the aim of implementing the principles of the European Charter for Researchers and the Code of Conduct for Recruitment regarding the working conditions of researchers and the selection and recruitment procedures at all career stages. The University is committed to complying with the principles of the Charter and the Code, in line with its own values, mission and strategic planning, and has taken the necessary steps to obtain the "HR Excellence in Research Award" from the European Commission. This award recognises the quality of the university's research environment and the initiatives taken to support researchers' activities and career development. Involving the entire community of UNIVPM researchers, PhD students and post-doctoral researchers, as well as technical and administrative staff, the university carried out a detailed internal analysis - through the administration of a questionnaire - to determine the current understanding of C&C principles and to assess the level of compliance of UNIVPM's policies and practices with these principles. The results of the questionnaire were then incorporated into the GAP analysis and later used to develop an action plan - to be implemented over the next 24 months - aimed at improving the implementation of C&C principles at the Università Politecnica delle Marche. On 19 December 2023, the documents required in the first phase of the procedure were approved by the Academic Bodies. On August 30, 2024, Università Politecnica delle Marche received the HR Excellence in Research award from the European Commission, following the adoption of an Action Plan to implement the principles of the European Charter for Researchers . This award recognizes the quality of the university’s research environment and its initiatives to support researchers' careers. The European Commission will conduct an initial review of the Action Plan's implementation in two years. HR Excellence in Research On 11 January 2023, the Università Politecnica delle Marche launched the HRS4R - Human Resources Strategy for Researchers - process required by the European Commission, with the aim of implementing the principles of the European Charter for Researchers and the Code of Conduct for Recruitment regarding the working conditions of researchers and the selection and recruitment procedures at all career stages. The University is committed to complying with the principles of the Charter and the Code, in line with its own values, mission and strategic planning, and has taken the necessary steps to obtain the "HR Excellence in Research Award" from the European Commission. This award recognises the quality of the university's research environment and the initiatives taken to support researchers' activities and career development. Involving the entire community of UNIVPM researchers, PhD students and post-doctoral researchers, as well as technical and administrative staff, the university carried out a detailed internal analysis - through the administration of a questionnaire - to determine the current understanding of C&C principles and to assess the level of compliance of UNIVPM's policies and practices with these principles. The results of the questionnaire were then incorporated into the GAP analysis and later used to develop an action plan - to be implemented over the next 24 months - aimed at improving the implementation of C&C principles at the Università Politecnica delle Marche. On 19 December 2023, the documents required in the first phase of the procedure were approved by the Academic Bodies. On August 30, 2024, Università Politecnica delle Marche received the HR Excellence in Research award from the European Commission, following the adoption of an Action Plan to implement the principles of the European Charter for Researchers . This award recognizes the quality of the university’s research environment and its initiatives to support researchers' careers. The European Commission will conduct an initial review of the Action Plan's implementation in two years. Social Media Policy La Policy in materia di Social Media (Account aperti e attivi: Facebook, X, Instagram, YouTube, Linkedin) Cosa postiamo sui social network e cosa non postiamo L’Università Politecnica delle Marche è presente nei diversi social media, nei profili istituzionali, di seguito riportati, per informare, comunicare e favorire la partecipazione e il dialogo. I social media non sostituiscono in nessun modo i compiti svolti dagli uffici competenti. Le informazioni complete ed aggiornate sono reperibili sul portale di Ateneo www.univpm.it e sui siti di Dipartimento e Facoltà ad esso connessi. Tramite i social media l’UnivPM diffonde informazioni su servizi, progetti e iniziative. I contenuti pubblicati possono riguardare informazioni istituzionali e di servizio, eventi, progetti, risultati della ricerca, azioni di coinvolgimento e partecipazione e aggiornamenti in situazioni di emergenza. L’Università Politecnica delle Marche può condividere contenuti di altri enti ed organizzazioni, previa autorizzazione o in caso di patrocinio. Fermo restando l’impegno nel verificare la precisione e l’attendibilità di questi contenuti, l’UnivPM non si assume alcuna responsabilità per eventuali informazioni errate e non aggiornate. Account ufficiali Gli account ufficiali sono: Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/UNIVPM Twitter: https://twitter.com/UnivPoliMarche Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/univpm/ Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/user/UNIVPM1 Linkedin: https://www.linkedin.com/school/47885 Netiquette Le "regole di conversazione" con i nostri interlocutori in rete sono un patto di dialogo. Qualsiasi interlocutore è responsabile dei messaggi che invia, dei contenuti che pubblica e delle opinioni che esprime. Non saranno comunque tollerati insulti, volgarità, offese, minacce, e in generale, atteggiamenti violenti. A tutti si chiede di esporre la propria opinione con correttezza e misura e di rispettare le opinioni altrui. L'interesse pubblico degli argomenti è un requisito essenziale: non è possibile utilizzare questi spazi per affrontare casi personali. Non è tollerata alcuna forma di pubblicità, spam o promozione di interessi privati o di attività illegali. Nei social network i contenuti pubblicati devono rispettare la privacy delle persone. Vanno evitati riferimenti a fatti o a dettagli privi di rilevanza pubblica, atteggiamenti violenti, offensivi o discriminatori rispetto al genere, orientamento sessuale, età, religione, convinzioni personali, orientamenti politici, origini etniche, disabilità. Va altresì evitata la pubblicazione di dati personali (caselle email, numeri di telefono, numeri di conto corrente, indirizzi), in caso contrario i contenuti postati saranno rimossi per tutelare le persone interessate. Non sono ammessi contenuti che violino il diritto d’autore né l’utilizzo non autorizzato di marchi registrati. L’Università Politecnica delle Marche modera i propri spazi a posteriori, ovvero in un momento successivo alla pubblicazione, allo scopo di contenere, nei tempi e nei modi ragionevolmente esigibili, eventuali comportamenti contrari alle regole d’uso. Nei casi più gravi - e in modo particolare in caso di mancato rispetto delle regole condivise in questo documento - l’Amministrazione si riserva la possibilità di cancellare i contenuti, allontanare gli utenti dai propri spazi e segnalarli ai filtri di moderazione del social network ospitante. Risposte Gli spazi social dell’Università Politecnica delle Marche vengono presidiati, di regola, dal lunedì al venerdì, dalle 9 alle 17:00. L’UnivPM si impegna a leggere i quesiti e i messaggi e a fornire, quando richiesta, una risposta pertinente nel più breve tempo possibile. I tempi di risposta variano in base alla tipologia di richiesta; nel caso in cui i canali social non siano lo strumento adeguato per soddisfare la richiesta la redazione provvederà ad informare sulle corrette modalità e uffici a cui rivolgersi. Trattamento dati personali Si ricorda che il trattamento dei dati personali degli utenti risponde alle policy per la gestione dei dati personali in uso sulle piattaforme utilizzate. I dati personali condivisi dagli utenti attraverso messaggi privati spediti direttamente ai canali dell’Università Politecnica delle Marche saranno trattati nel rispetto delle norme nazionali e comunitarie vigenti in materia di trattamento dei dati personali. Link di riferimento https://www.univpm.it/Entra/Privacy Per quanto non espressamente previsto, si fa rinvio alle norme e alle disposizioni legislative e regolamentari, nazionali e comunitarie vigenti in materia. Social Media Policy La Policy in materia di Social Media (Account aperti e attivi: Facebook, X, Instagram, YouTube, Linkedin) Cosa postiamo sui social network e cosa non postiamo L’Università Politecnica delle Marche è presente nei diversi social media, nei profili istituzionali, di seguito riportati, per informare, comunicare e favorire la partecipazione e il dialogo. I social media non sostituiscono in nessun modo i compiti svolti dagli uffici competenti. Le informazioni complete ed aggiornate sono reperibili sul portale di Ateneo www.univpm.it e sui siti di Dipartimento e Facoltà ad esso connessi. Tramite i social media l’UnivPM diffonde informazioni su servizi, progetti e iniziative. I contenuti pubblicati possono riguardare informazioni istituzionali e di servizio, eventi, progetti, risultati della ricerca, azioni di coinvolgimento e partecipazione e aggiornamenti in situazioni di emergenza. L’Università Politecnica delle Marche può condividere contenuti di altri enti ed organizzazioni, previa autorizzazione o in caso di patrocinio. Fermo restando l’impegno nel verificare la precisione e l’attendibilità di questi contenuti, l’UnivPM non si assume alcuna responsabilità per eventuali informazioni errate e non aggiornate. Account ufficiali Gli account ufficiali sono: Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/UNIVPM Twitter: https://twitter.com/UnivPoliMarche Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/univpm/ Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/user/UNIVPM1 Linkedin: https://www.linkedin.com/school/47885 Netiquette Le "regole di conversazione" con i nostri interlocutori in rete sono un patto di dialogo. Qualsiasi interlocutore è responsabile dei messaggi che invia, dei contenuti che pubblica e delle opinioni che esprime. Non saranno comunque tollerati insulti, volgarità, offese, minacce, e in generale, atteggiamenti violenti. A tutti si chiede di esporre la propria opinione con correttezza e misura e di rispettare le opinioni altrui. L'interesse pubblico degli argomenti è un requisito essenziale: non è possibile utilizzare questi spazi per affrontare casi personali. Non è tollerata alcuna forma di pubblicità, spam o promozione di interessi privati o di attività illegali. Nei social network i contenuti pubblicati devono rispettare la privacy delle persone. Vanno evitati riferimenti a fatti o a dettagli privi di rilevanza pubblica, atteggiamenti violenti, offensivi o discriminatori rispetto al genere, orientamento sessuale, età, religione, convinzioni personali, orientamenti politici, origini etniche, disabilità. Va altresì evitata la pubblicazione di dati personali (caselle email, numeri di telefono, numeri di conto corrente, indirizzi), in caso contrario i contenuti postati saranno rimossi per tutelare le persone interessate. Non sono ammessi contenuti che violino il diritto d’autore né l’utilizzo non autorizzato di marchi registrati. L’Università Politecnica delle Marche modera i propri spazi a posteriori, ovvero in un momento successivo alla pubblicazione, allo scopo di contenere, nei tempi e nei modi ragionevolmente esigibili, eventuali comportamenti contrari alle regole d’uso. Nei casi più gravi - e in modo particolare in caso di mancato rispetto delle regole condivise in questo documento - l’Amministrazione si riserva la possibilità di cancellare i contenuti, allontanare gli utenti dai propri spazi e segnalarli ai filtri di moderazione del social network ospitante. Risposte Gli spazi social dell’Università Politecnica delle Marche vengono presidiati, di regola, dal lunedì al venerdì, dalle 9 alle 17:00. L’UnivPM si impegna a leggere i quesiti e i messaggi e a fornire, quando richiesta, una risposta pertinente nel più breve tempo possibile. I tempi di risposta variano in base alla tipologia di richiesta; nel caso in cui i canali social non siano lo strumento adeguato per soddisfare la richiesta la redazione provvederà ad informare sulle corrette modalità e uffici a cui rivolgersi. Trattamento dati personali Si ricorda che il trattamento dei dati personali degli utenti risponde alle policy per la gestione dei dati personali in uso sulle piattaforme utilizzate. I dati personali condivisi dagli utenti attraverso messaggi privati spediti direttamente ai canali dell’Università Politecnica delle Marche saranno trattati nel rispetto delle norme nazionali e comunitarie vigenti in materia di trattamento dei dati personali. Link di riferimento https://www.univpm.it/Entra/Privacy Per quanto non espressamente previsto, si fa rinvio alle norme e alle disposizioni legislative e regolamentari, nazionali e comunitarie vigenti in materia. Social Media Policy La Policy in materia di Social Media (Account aperti e attivi: Facebook, X, Instagram, YouTube, Linkedin) Cosa postiamo sui social network e cosa non postiamo L’Università Politecnica delle Marche è presente nei diversi social media, nei profili istituzionali, di seguito riportati, per informare, comunicare e favorire la partecipazione e il dialogo. I social media non sostituiscono in nessun modo i compiti svolti dagli uffici competenti. Le informazioni complete ed aggiornate sono reperibili sul portale di Ateneo www.univpm.it e sui siti di Dipartimento e Facoltà ad esso connessi. Tramite i social media l’UnivPM diffonde informazioni su servizi, progetti e iniziative. I contenuti pubblicati possono riguardare informazioni istituzionali e di servizio, eventi, progetti, risultati della ricerca, azioni di coinvolgimento e partecipazione e aggiornamenti in situazioni di emergenza. L’Università Politecnica delle Marche può condividere contenuti di altri enti ed organizzazioni, previa autorizzazione o in caso di patrocinio. Fermo restando l’impegno nel verificare la precisione e l’attendibilità di questi contenuti, l’UnivPM non si assume alcuna responsabilità per eventuali informazioni errate e non aggiornate. Account ufficiali Gli account ufficiali sono: Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/UNIVPM Twitter: https://twitter.com/UnivPoliMarche Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/univpm/ Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/user/UNIVPM1 Linkedin: https://www.linkedin.com/school/47885 Netiquette Le "regole di conversazione" con i nostri interlocutori in rete sono un patto di dialogo. Qualsiasi interlocutore è responsabile dei messaggi che invia, dei contenuti che pubblica e delle opinioni che esprime. Non saranno comunque tollerati insulti, volgarità, offese, minacce, e in generale, atteggiamenti violenti. A tutti si chiede di esporre la propria opinione con correttezza e misura e di rispettare le opinioni altrui. L'interesse pubblico degli argomenti è un requisito essenziale: non è possibile utilizzare questi spazi per affrontare casi personali. Non è tollerata alcuna forma di pubblicità, spam o promozione di interessi privati o di attività illegali. Nei social network i contenuti pubblicati devono rispettare la privacy delle persone. Vanno evitati riferimenti a fatti o a dettagli privi di rilevanza pubblica, atteggiamenti violenti, offensivi o discriminatori rispetto al genere, orientamento sessuale, età, religione, convinzioni personali, orientamenti politici, origini etniche, disabilità. Va altresì evitata la pubblicazione di dati personali (caselle email, numeri di telefono, numeri di conto corrente, indirizzi), in caso contrario i contenuti postati saranno rimossi per tutelare le persone interessate. Non sono ammessi contenuti che violino il diritto d’autore né l’utilizzo non autorizzato di marchi registrati. L’Università Politecnica delle Marche modera i propri spazi a posteriori, ovvero in un momento successivo alla pubblicazione, allo scopo di contenere, nei tempi e nei modi ragionevolmente esigibili, eventuali comportamenti contrari alle regole d’uso. Nei casi più gravi - e in modo particolare in caso di mancato rispetto delle regole condivise in questo documento - l’Amministrazione si riserva la possibilità di cancellare i contenuti, allontanare gli utenti dai propri spazi e segnalarli ai filtri di moderazione del social network ospitante. Risposte Gli spazi social dell’Università Politecnica delle Marche vengono presidiati, di regola, dal lunedì al venerdì, dalle 9 alle 17:00. L’UnivPM si impegna a leggere i quesiti e i messaggi e a fornire, quando richiesta, una risposta pertinente nel più breve tempo possibile. I tempi di risposta variano in base alla tipologia di richiesta; nel caso in cui i canali social non siano lo strumento adeguato per soddisfare la richiesta la redazione provvederà ad informare sulle corrette modalità e uffici a cui rivolgersi. Trattamento dati personali Si ricorda che il trattamento dei dati personali degli utenti risponde alle policy per la gestione dei dati personali in uso sulle piattaforme utilizzate. Opportunities for foreign Teachers and Staff Università Politecnica delle Marche promotes international mobility initiatives for teaching and training purposes. In this section, you can learn about opportunities for teaching and administrative staff to carry out a period of teaching or training at UNIVPM. Teaching and Staff mobilities for capacity building purposes - ITACA Call for applications for 4 international mobility grants for lecturers and staff from the 10 African universities participating in the project, for capacity building activities. Deadline: 18 march 2026, 12.00 a.m. International mobilities for Lecturers - ITACA Call for applications for 15 international mobility grants for lecturers from the 10 African universities participating in the project for teaching purposes. Deadline: 18 march 2026, 12.00 a.m. Erasmus+ Staff Week The Staff Mobility for Training action of the Erasmus+ Programme represents an important professional training opportunity for staff at higher education institutions. The initiative offers the chance to undertake a short in-person experience at a higher education institution in one of the countries participating in the programme, either through job shadowing in offices similar to those of the participant's own institution, or by attending events organised by other European universities on topics relevant to the participant's work (Staff Week). Visiting Scientist Opportunities for administrative and academic staff to undertake training or teaching periods at UNIVPM. Opportunities for foreign Teachers and Staff Università Politecnica delle Marche promotes international mobility initiatives for teaching and training purposes. In this section, you can learn about opportunities for teaching and administrative staff to carry out a period of teaching or training at UNIVPM. Teaching and Staff mobilities for capacity building purposes - ITACA Call for applications for 4 international mobility grants for lecturers and staff from the 10 African universities participating in the project, for capacity building activities. Deadline: 18 march 2026, 12.00 a.m. International mobilities for Lecturers - ITACA Call for applications for 15 international mobility grants for lecturers from the 10 African universities participating in the project for teaching purposes. Deadline: 18 march 2026, 12.00 a.m. Erasmus+ Staff Week The Staff Mobility for Training action of the Erasmus+ Programme represents an important professional training opportunity for staff at higher education institutions. The initiative offers the chance to undertake a short in-person experience at a higher education institution in one of the countries participating in the programme, either through job shadowing in offices similar to those of the participant's own institution, or by attending events organised by other European universities on topics relevant to the participant's work (Staff Week). Visiting Scientist Opportunities for administrative and academic staff to undertake training or teaching periods at UNIVPM. Opportunities for foreign Teachers and Staff Università Politecnica delle Marche promotes international mobility initiatives for teaching and training purposes. In this section, you can learn about opportunities for teaching and administrative staff to carry out a period of teaching or training at UNIVPM. Deadline: 18 march 2026, 12.00 a.m. Erasmus+ Staff Week The Staff Mobility for Training action of the Erasmus+ Programme represents an important professional training opportunity for staff at higher education institutions. The initiative offers the chance to undertake a short in-person experience at a higher education institution in one of the countries participating in the programme, either through job shadowing in offices similar to those of the participant's own institution, or by attending events organised by other European universities on topics relevant to the participant's work (Staff Week). Opportunities for foreign Teachers and Staff Università Politecnica delle Marche promotes international mobility initiatives for teaching and training purposes. In this section, you can learn about opportunities for teaching and administrative staff to carry out a period of teaching or training at UNIVPM. Teaching and Staff mobilities for capacity building purposes - ITACA Call for applications for 4 international mobility grants for lecturers and staff from the 10 African universities participating in the project, for capacity building activities. Deadline: 18 march 2026, 12.00 a.m. International mobilities for Lecturers - ITACA Call for applications for 15 international mobility grants for lecturers from the 10 African universities participating in the project for teaching purposes. Deadline: 18 march 2026, 12.00 a.m. Erasmus+ Staff Week The Staff Mobility for Training action of the Erasmus+ Programme represents an important professional training opportunity for staff at higher education institutions. The initiative offers the chance to undertake a short in-person experience at a higher education institution in one of the countries participating in the programme, either through job shadowing in offices similar to those of the participant's own institution, or by attending events organised by other European universities on topics relevant to the participant's work (Staff Week). Visiting Scientist Opportunities for administrative and academic staff to undertake training or teaching periods at UNIVPM. Download My UnivpmOrienta app and discover features designed to help you choose the right course for you! With MyUnivpmOrienta , you can learn about the educational offerings and services of the Università Politecnica delle Marche and receive information about orientation initiatives and courses of study that interest you. In addition, by installing the app on your cell phone, you will be able to access a virtual tour of our University's classrooms and laboratories and be informed in real time about all the events, news and appointments that Univpm has planned for you! Univpm App App Univpm – Marche Politechnic University a click away My Univpm Orienta - The APP to learn about the most suitable course for you! Download My UnivpmOrienta app and discover features designed to help you choose the right course for you! With MyUnivpmOrienta , you can learn about the educational offerings and services of the Università Politecnica delle Marche and receive information about orientation initiatives and courses of study that interest you. In addition, by installing the app on your cell phone, you will be able to access a virtual tour of our University's classrooms and laboratories and be informed in real time about all the events, news and appointments that Univpm has planned for you! The application is available for free download at: My Univpm - The Official Application to manage your Univpm career Thanks to MyUnivpm you will be able to: Consult your training offer Check student news View available exam sessions Book an exam Accept/reject grades Refer student secretariat’s timetables and contacts View virtual badge for enrolled students as of the year 2024/2025 See documentation for booking procedure MyUnivpm Agenda - App for Class Calendar Management and Attendance Tracking Thanks to MyUnivpm you will be able to: Consult lesson timetable View availability of teaching classrooms Detect your attendance in class BiblioUnivpm - App for Univpm Library Catalogue Consultation Thanks to BiblioUnivpm you will be able to: Search books, magazines or other materials, using text search or barcode reading Find out the availability of documents Book text lending Check deadlines and status of loans made International International Students Website Opportunities abroad Incoming mobility European Universities alliance SUNRISE Opportunities for international students International Partners International policies and strategies Contacts Follow us Download App 5 x 1000 Last update: 12-03-2025 Torna in cima Torna al corpo Disclaimer UnivPM guarantees equality and equal opportunities for all people in study, research and work.
