International mobility for teaching staff In this section UNIVPM teaching staff can discover the opportunities of teaching and training abroad Thanks to the Erasmus+ Programme, professors at our University can carry out a EU-funded period of teaching or training in one of the Partner Institutions of Università Politecnica delle Marche thus improving their professional curriculum The list of Partner Institutions where the teaching or training mobility can be performed is currently being updated but will soon be made available by the International Relations Office. The new seven years of the Erasmus+ Programme 2021-2027 again includes, as in the previous period 2014-2020, staff mobility for teaching or training through Action 1 in a Higher Education Institute who is Partner of their University of employment. The eligible countries where the chosen Hosting Institution should be located are EU and extra-EU countries called ‘ Programme Countries ’, which are the following: EU Member States, Norway, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Acceding countries, Candidate countries and potential candidates: Republic of North Macedonia, Republic of Turkey and Republic of Serbia. In addition, it is possible to carry out the teaching or training mobility in Institutes located in the so-called ‘ Partner Countries ’, in other terms third-countries not associated to the Programme, if the University of employment has cooperation agreements and available grants to fund this kind of mobility. To obtain more information on this opportunity, please address your request to the International Relations Office at the contacts below. International mobility for teaching staff In this section UNIVPM teaching staff can discover the opportunities of teaching and training abroad Thanks to the Erasmus+ Programme, professors at our University can carry out a EU-funded period of teaching or training in one of the Partner Institutions of Università Politecnica delle Marche thus improving their professional curriculum The list of Partner Institutions where the teaching or training mobility can be performed is currently being updated but will soon be made available by the International Relations Office. The new seven years of the Erasmus+ Programme 2021-2027 again includes, as in the previous period 2014-2020, staff mobility for teaching or training through Action 1 in a Higher Education Institute who is Partner of their University of employment. The eligible countries where the chosen Hosting Institution should be located are EU and extra-EU countries called ‘ Programme Countries ’, which are the following: EU Member States, Norway, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Acceding countries, Candidate countries and potential candidates: Republic of North Macedonia, Republic of Turkey and Republic of Serbia. In addition, it is possible to carry out the teaching or training mobility in Institutes located in the so-called ‘ Partner Countries ’, in other terms third-countries not associated to the Programme, if the University of employment has cooperation agreements and available grants to fund this kind of mobility. To obtain more information on this opportunity, please address your request to the International Relations Office at the contacts below. The Consortium offers various mobility opportunities abroad for teaching and training. Deadline: 5 March 2023 Erasmus+ Call for Staff Training abroad - SEND Consortium Marche Polytechnic University is participating in the Erasmus+ project coordinated by the SEND Mobility Consortium . The call, aimed at both teaching and non-teaching staff of the universities affiliated with the Consortium, funds training periods abroad . Check available calls Erasmus+ Call for Staff Teaching and Training mobilities abroad - TUCEP Consortium Marche Polytechnic University is participating in the Erasmus+ project coordinated by the TUCEP Consortium . The call, aimed at both teaching and non-teaching staff of the universities affiliated with the Consortium, funds teaching and training periods abroad . Check available calls Erasmus+ call for administrative staff This Call aims to assign 5 grants to administrative staff at UNIVPM to perform an international mobility experience within the Erasmus+ Programme "Staff mobility for training (STT)" action. Call expired on 31 st January 2020 Erasmus+ Call for Staff Training abroad EU4EU EuGen Consortium Marche Polytechnic University is participating in the Erasmus+ project coordinated by the EU4EU Consortium . The call, aimed at non-teaching staff of the universities affiliated with the Consortium, funds training periods abroad . Erasmus+ Staff Week Among the mobility opportunities for staff of higher education institutions funded by the Erasmus+ Programme, international mobility for training purposes (Staff Mobility for Training) is an important opportunity for professional development. The action provides the opportunity to undertake a short experience in a higher education institution in one of the countries participating in the Programme. Staff Mobility can be carried out in the following ways: Job-shadowing: training through job-shadowing in an office of another European university, performing work activities relevant to their role. The activity is an opportunity to acquire skills, techniques and methods to be applied specifically in the work activity and to encourage the exchange of experiences and good practices; it also stimulates the use of foreign languages, teamwork and cooperation between colleagues. In order to carry out the job-shadowing experience, it is necessary to independently identify the host organisation and agree on a detailed daily schedule; Staff Week: training events promoted by European universities, usually focused on specific themes, whose participation is linked to the submission of an application according to certain deadlines. The Polytechnic University of Marche regularly hosts staff from other higher education institutions, either for job-shadowing initiatives which are promoted individually by the participants or through the organisation of Staff Weeks. Staff Weeks organised by the Erasmus+ Consortium "Uniadrion Italy" The Erasmus+ Consortium “Uniadrion Italy”, coordinated by the Polytechnic University of Marche, is made up of 11 Italian universities that are members of UniAdrion, an association of universities in the Adriatic-Ionian area founded in Ancona in 2000 with the aim of fostering cooperation between universities and research centres in the area. The UniAdrion association brings together the most prestigious universities in the area and currently has 53 members from Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Croatia, Greece, Italy, Montenegro, North Macedonia, San Marino, Serbia and Slovenia. Since 2014, when the European Council officially endorsed the “European Strategy for the Adriatic-Ionian Region” (EUSAIR), UniAdrion has been contributing to the realisation of the Strategy's objectives in cooperation with various stakeholders operating in the area. The creation of a Mobility Consortium of the Italian universities participating in UniAdrion allows them to present themselves to the institutions of the Western Balkans as a regional system, with the consequent aim of strengthening regional cooperation in order to solve common challenges and problems. Staff Weeks organised by the Erasmus+ Consortium “Uniadrion Italy” are open to academic and non-academic staff involved in university policy and decision-making processes in their universities. They are useful for sharing experiences in the field of governance and for attending seminars given by leading personalities in the context of the Adriatic-Ionian macro-region. For more information about the Erasmus+ Consortium “Uniadrion Italy” visit www.uniadrionitaly.it Staff Week Marche from 24 to 28 November 2025 - Ancona The Università Politecnica delle Marche, as coordinator of the Erasmus+ Consortium ‘UniAdrion Italy’, is organising a staff week from 24 to 28 November 2025, combined with the first edition of the Western Balkans Promotion Fair, and hosted jointly by UNIVPM and the University of Teramo. The initiative combines the Staff Week of the Erasmus+ Consortium ‘Uniadrion Italy’ and the Western Balkans Promotion Fair, creating an important opportunity for meeting and collaboration between universities in Italy, Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro and North Macedonia. The aim is to strengthen academic cooperation, encourage international exchanges and promote new Erasmus+ mobility opportunities for students and university staff in the Adriatic-Ionian area. This first edition of the Western Balkans Promotion Fair is not only a celebration of relations between Italy and the Western Balkans, but also a shared commitment to a more connected, sustainable and inclusive European future. The two events represent a concrete step towards the creation of a more cohesive and dynamic Adriatic-Ionian academic community. The aim of the event was to strengthen cooperation between academic institutions in the Adriatic-Ionian region and to promote future joint initiatives. The 23 participants came from Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro and North Macedonia and represented the following universities: Agricultural University of Tirana (Albania) University of Tirana (Albania) University of Banja Luka (Bosnia and Herzegovina) “Dzemal Bijedic” University of Mostar (Bosnia and Herzegovina) University of Sarajevo (Bosnia and Herzegovina) University of Montenegro (Montenegro) University “St. Kliment Ohridski” of Bitola (North Macedonia) During the week, the participants visited the teaching facilities and laboratories of the Polytechnic University of Marche, the University of Teramo and the University of Ferrara, which are also part of the Erasmus+ Consortium “Uniadrion Italy”. They also took part in some interactive seminars on the Erasmus+ international mobility programmes and on the active participation of young students in the institutional activities of their universities. Erasmus+ Staff Week Among the mobility opportunities for staff of higher education institutions funded by the Erasmus+ Programme, international mobility for training purposes (Staff Mobility for Training) is an important opportunity for professional development. The action provides the opportunity to undertake a short experience in a higher education institution in one of the countries participating in the Programme. Staff Mobility can be carried out in the following ways: Job-shadowing: training through job-shadowing in an office of another European university, performing work activities relevant to their role. The activity is an opportunity to acquire skills, techniques and methods to be applied specifically in the work activity and to encourage the exchange of experiences and good practices; it also stimulates the use of foreign languages, teamwork and cooperation between colleagues. In order to carry out the job-shadowing experience, it is necessary to independently identify the host organisation and agree on a detailed daily schedule; Staff Week: training events promoted by European universities, usually focused on specific themes, whose participation is linked to the submission of an application according to certain deadlines. The Polytechnic University of Marche regularly hosts staff from other higher education institutions, either for job-shadowing initiatives which are promoted individually by the participants or through the organisation of Staff Weeks. Staff Weeks organised by the Erasmus+ Consortium "Uniadrion Italy" The Erasmus+ Consortium “Uniadrion Italy”, coordinated by the Polytechnic University of Marche, is made up of 11 Italian universities that are members of UniAdrion, an association of universities in the Adriatic-Ionian area founded in Ancona in 2000 with the aim of fostering cooperation between universities and research centres in the area. The UniAdrion association brings together the most prestigious universities in the area and currently has 53 members from Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Croatia, Greece, Italy, Montenegro, North Macedonia, San Marino, Serbia and Slovenia. Since 2014, when the European Council officially endorsed the “European Strategy for the Adriatic-Ionian Region” (EUSAIR), UniAdrion has been contributing to the realisation of the Strategy's objectives in cooperation with various stakeholders operating in the area. The creation of a Mobility Consortium of the Italian universities participating in UniAdrion allows them to present themselves to the institutions of the Western Balkans as a regional system, with the consequent aim of strengthening regional cooperation in order to solve common challenges and problems. Staff Weeks organised by the Erasmus+ Consortium “Uniadrion Italy” are open to academic and non-academic staff involved in university policy and decision-making processes in their universities. They are useful for sharing experiences in the field of governance and for attending seminars given by leading personalities in the context of the Adriatic-Ionian macro-region. For more information about the Erasmus+ Consortium “Uniadrion Italy” visit www.uniadrionitaly.it Staff Week Marche from 24 to 28 November 2025 - Ancona The Università Politecnica delle Marche, as coordinator of the Erasmus+ Consortium ‘UniAdrion Italy’, is organising a staff week from 24 to 28 November 2025, combined with the first edition of the Western Balkans Promotion Fair, and hosted jointly by UNIVPM and the University of Teramo. The initiative combines the Staff Week of the Erasmus+ Consortium ‘Uniadrion Italy’ and the Western Balkans Promotion Fair, creating an important opportunity for meeting and collaboration between universities in Italy, Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro and North Macedonia. The aim is to strengthen academic cooperation, encourage international exchanges and promote new Erasmus+ mobility opportunities for students and university staff in the Adriatic-Ionian area. This first edition of the Western Balkans Promotion Fair is not only a celebration of relations between Italy and the Western Balkans, but also a shared commitment to a more connected, sustainable and inclusive European future. The two events represent a concrete step towards the creation of a more cohesive and dynamic Adriatic-Ionian academic community. Here below you can download: The full programme of the staff week The flyer of the staff week The flyer of the Western Balkan Fair in Ancona Staff Week Marche from 15 to 19 July 2024 - Ancona The second edition of the “Staff Week Marche” took place from 15 to 19 July 2024 and was organised by the Polytechnic University of Marche, as a coordinator of the Erasmus+ Consortium “Uniadrion Italy”. The aim of the event was to strengthen cooperation between academic institutions in the Adriatic-Ionian region and to promote future joint initiatives. The 23 participants came from Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro and North Macedonia and represented the following universities: Agricultural University of Tirana (Albania) University of Tirana (Albania) University of Banja Luka (Bosnia and Herzegovina) “Dzemal Bijedic” University of Mostar (Bosnia and Herzegovina) University of Sarajevo (Bosnia and Herzegovina) University of Montenegro (Montenegro) University “St. Kliment Ohridski” of Bitola (North Macedonia) During the week, the participants visited the teaching facilities and laboratories of the Polytechnic University of Marche, the University of Teramo and the University of Ferrara, which are also part of the Erasmus+ Consortium “Uniadrion Italy”. They also took part in some interactive seminars on the Erasmus+ international mobility programmes and on the active participation of young students in the institutional activities of their universities. Staff Week Marche from 17 to 21 July 2023 - Ancona The first edition of the Staff Week organised in Ancona in the framework of the Erasmus+ Consortium “Uniadrion Italy” took place from 17 to 21 July 2023 and was named “Staff Week Marche” because the 36 participants had the opportunity to visit all four universities of the Marche Region (Polytechnic University of Marche, Consortium Coordinator, University of Macerata, University of Camerino, “Carlo Bo” University of Urbino). Erasmus+ Staff Week Among the mobility opportunities for staff of higher education institutions funded by the Erasmus+ Programme, international mobility for training purposes (Staff Mobility for Training) is an important opportunity for professional development. The action provides the opportunity to undertake a short experience in a higher education institution in one of the countries participating in the Programme. Staff Mobility can be carried out in the following ways: Job-shadowing: training through job-shadowing in an office of another European university, performing work activities relevant to their role. The activity is an opportunity to acquire skills, techniques and methods to be applied specifically in the work activity and to encourage the exchange of experiences and good practices; it also stimulates the use of foreign languages, teamwork and cooperation between colleagues. In order to carry out the job-shadowing experience, it is necessary to independently identify the host organisation and agree on a detailed daily schedule; Staff Week: training events promoted by European universities, usually focused on specific themes, whose participation is linked to the submission of an application according to certain deadlines. The Polytechnic University of Marche regularly hosts staff from other higher education institutions, either for job-shadowing initiatives which are promoted individually by the participants or through the organisation of Staff Weeks. Staff Weeks organised by the Erasmus+ Consortium "Uniadrion Italy" The Erasmus+ Consortium “Uniadrion Italy”, coordinated by the Polytechnic University of Marche, is made up of 11 Italian universities that are members of UniAdrion, an association of universities in the Adriatic-Ionian area founded in Ancona in 2000 with the aim of fostering cooperation between universities and research centres in the area. The UniAdrion association brings together the most prestigious universities in the area and currently has 53 members from Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Croatia, Greece, Italy, Montenegro, North Macedonia, San Marino, Serbia and Slovenia. Since 2014, when the European Council officially endorsed the “European Strategy for the Adriatic-Ionian Region” (EUSAIR), UniAdrion has been contributing to the realisation of the Strategy's objectives in cooperation with various stakeholders operating in the area. The creation of a Mobility Consortium of the Italian universities participating in UniAdrion allows them to present themselves to the institutions of the Western Balkans as a regional system, with the consequent aim of strengthening regional cooperation in order to solve common challenges and problems. Staff Weeks organised by the Erasmus+ Consortium “Uniadrion Italy” are open to academic and non-academic staff involved in university policy and decision-making processes in their universities. They are useful for sharing experiences in the field of governance and for attending seminars given by leading personalities in the context of the Adriatic-Ionian macro-region. For more information about the Erasmus+ Consortium “Uniadrion Italy” visit www.uniadrionitaly.it Staff Week Marche from 24 to 28 November 2025 - Ancona The Università Politecnica delle Marche, as coordinator of the Erasmus+ Consortium ‘UniAdrion Italy’, is organising a staff week from 24 to 28 November 2025, combined with the first edition of the Western Balkans Promotion Fair, and hosted jointly by UNIVPM and the University of Teramo. The initiative combines the Staff Week of the Erasmus+ Consortium ‘Uniadrion Italy’ and the Western Balkans Promotion Fair, creating an important opportunity for meeting and collaboration between universities in Italy, Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro and North Macedonia. The aim is to strengthen academic cooperation, encourage international exchanges and promote new Erasmus+ mobility opportunities for students and university staff in the Adriatic-Ionian area. This first edition of the Western Balkans Promotion Fair is not only a celebration of relations between Italy and the Western Balkans, but also a shared commitment to a more connected, sustainable and inclusive European future. The two events represent a concrete step towards the creation of a more cohesive and dynamic Adriatic-Ionian academic community. Here below you can download: The full programme of the staff week The flyer of the staff week The flyer of the Western Balkan Fair in Ancona Staff Week Marche from 15 to 19 July 2024 - Ancona The second edition of the “Staff Week Marche” took place from 15 to 19 July 2024 and was organised by the Polytechnic University of Marche, as a coordinator of the Erasmus+ Consortium “Uniadrion Italy”. The aim of the event was to strengthen cooperation between academic institutions in the Adriatic-Ionian region and to promote future joint initiatives. The 23 participants came from Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro and North Macedonia and represented the following universities: Agricultural University of Tirana (Albania) University of Tirana (Albania) University of Banja Luka (Bosnia and Herzegovina) “Dzemal Bijedic” University of Mostar (Bosnia and Herzegovina) University of Sarajevo (Bosnia and Herzegovina) University of Montenegro (Montenegro) University “St. Kliment Ohridski” of Bitola (North Macedonia) During the week, the participants visited the teaching facilities and laboratories of the Polytechnic University of Marche, the University of Teramo and the University of Ferrara, which are also part of the Erasmus+ Consortium “Uniadrion Italy”. They also took part in some interactive seminars on the Erasmus+ international mobility programmes and on the active participation of young students in the institutional activities of their universities. Staff Week Marche from 17 to 21 July 2023 - Ancona The first edition of the Staff Week organised in Ancona in the framework of the Erasmus+ Consortium “Uniadrion Italy” took place from 17 to 21 July 2023 and was named “Staff Week Marche” because the 36 participants had the opportunity to visit all four universities of the Marche Region (Polytechnic University of Marche, Consortium Coordinator, University of Macerata, University of Camerino, “Carlo Bo” University of Urbino). Bando per l'assegnazione di contributi finanziari per Visiting Scientist A.A. 2017/2018 Nell’ambito delle politiche di internazionalizzazione dell’Ateneo ed al fine di incentivare la mobilità in entrata di studiosi provenienti dall’estero, è indetta una selezione a favore di studiosi di chiara fama con comprovata esperienza scientifica provenienti da Università, Centri di Ricerca o Enti stranieri, per l’assegnazione di contributi per lo svolgimento di attività di didattica e ricerca presso un Dipartimento dell’Università Politecnica delle Marche. A chi è rivolto: Il bando Visiting Scientist prevede l’assegnazione di contributi a studiosi di chiara fama con comprovata esperienza scientifica, provenienti dall’estero ed afferenti ad Università o Centri di Ricerca stranieri. Gli studiosi svolgeranno la loro attività di didattica e ricerca presso un Dipartimento dell’Università Politecnica delle Marche. Durata della visita Il periodo di permanenza del Visiting Scientist dovrà essere non inferiore ad un (1) mese e non superiore a tre (3) mesi. Periodo della visita Le visite degli studiosi stranieri dovranno avere luogo nel periodo compreso tra il 1 gennaio 2018 e il 31 Dicembre 2018 . Condizioni economiche Al Visiting Scientist sarà assegnato un contributo pari ad € 3.000 (tremila) mensili, lordo percipiente. E’ previsto anche il contributo per il rimborso delle spese di un solo viaggio di andata e ritorno in classe economica per un tetto massimo di € 1000 (mille) per i Visiting Scientist provenienti da paesi europei e € 2000 (duemila) per i Visiting Scientist provenienti da paesi extra europei. Bando per l'assegnazione di contributi finanziari per Visiting Scientist A.A. 2017/2018 Nell’ambito delle politiche di internazionalizzazione dell’Ateneo ed al fine di incentivare la mobilità in entrata di studiosi provenienti dall’estero, è indetta una selezione a favore di studiosi di chiara fama con comprovata esperienza scientifica provenienti da Università, Centri di Ricerca o Enti stranieri, per l’assegnazione di contributi per lo svolgimento di attività di didattica e ricerca presso un Dipartimento dell’Università Politecnica delle Marche. A chi è rivolto: Il bando Visiting Scientist prevede l’assegnazione di contributi a studiosi di chiara fama con comprovata esperienza scientifica, provenienti dall’estero ed afferenti ad Università o Centri di Ricerca stranieri. Gli studiosi svolgeranno la loro attività di didattica e ricerca presso un Dipartimento dell’Università Politecnica delle Marche. Durata della visita Il periodo di permanenza del Visiting Scientist dovrà essere non inferiore ad un (1) mese e non superiore a tre (3) mesi. Periodo della visita Le visite degli studiosi stranieri dovranno avere luogo nel periodo compreso tra il 1 gennaio 2018 e il 31 Dicembre 2018 . Condizioni economiche Al Visiting Scientist sarà assegnato un contributo pari ad € 3.000 (tremila) mensili, lordo percipiente. E’ previsto anche il contributo per il rimborso delle spese di un solo viaggio di andata e ritorno in classe economica per un tetto massimo di € 1000 (mille) per i Visiting Scientist provenienti da paesi europei e € 2000 (duemila) per i Visiting Scientist provenienti da paesi extra europei. Presentazione delle domande e documenti da allegare: Le candidature potranno essere presentate da Docenti e Ricercatori dell’Università Politecnica delle Marche, che saranno i Referenti dei Visiting Scientist presso il proprio Dipartimento, utilizzando il modello allegato (Application Form: Allegato 1) e dovranno essere corredate da: . Lettera di accettazione da parte del Visiting Scientist . Curriculum Vitae del Visiting Scientist . Elenco delle pubblicazioni scientifiche del Visiting Scientist, con indicazione delle citazioni alla data della domanda Le proposte sottoscritte dal Referente del Visiting Scientist (professori e/o ricercatori dell’UNIVPM) dovranno essere trasmesse via email in un unico file in PDF, con i documenti allegati richiesti, all’indirizzo e-mail: international@univpm.it entro e non oltre le ore 13.00 del 4 Dicembre 2017 . Non saranno accettate candidature pervenute in formato cartaceo, né eventuali candidature incomplete o pervenute oltre la data e l’ora di scadenza. Call for Applications Lectures from Africa to UNIVPM ITACA Project "Internationalizing ITalian ACademia with Africa" - Teaching Within the ITACA Project, a Call for Applications is issued to award a maximum of 15 international mobility grants for Lecturers from the 10 African Partner Universities to Università Politecnica delle Marche (UNIVPM), Ancona – Italy. The mobility aims at sharing knowledge and teaching methodologies in the following ITACA thematic areas: Sustainable Management & Entrepreneurship, Orange Economy, Green Economy, Agri-Food, Energy & Water. This purpose will be pursued by enabling Lecturers to participate in teaching and/or co-teaching activities at UNIVPM. During the mobility period, UNIVPM faculty members may provide additional opportunities such as academic research activities, seminars, workshops aimed at exchanging best practices, and the establishment and/or development of scientific collaboration. The mobility shall have an actual duration of 21 days, excluding travel days, and must be completed by 31 May 2026. The exact mobility period must be agreed upon with Università Politecnica delle Marche. Deadline: 18 marzo 2026 alle ore 12:00 (CET). Call for Applications Lectures from Africa to UNIVPM ITACA Project "Internationalizing ITalian ACademia with Africa" - Teaching Within the ITACA Project, a Call for Applications is issued to award a maximum of 15 international mobility grants for Lecturers from the 10 African Partner Universities to Università Politecnica delle Marche (UNIVPM), Ancona – Italy. The mobility aims at sharing knowledge and teaching methodologies in the following ITACA thematic areas: Sustainable Management & Entrepreneurship, Orange Economy, Green Economy, Agri-Food, Energy & Water. This purpose will be pursued by enabling Lecturers to participate in teaching and/or co-teaching activities at UNIVPM. During the mobility period, UNIVPM faculty members may provide additional opportunities such as academic research activities, seminars, workshops aimed at exchanging best practices, and the establishment and/or development of scientific collaboration. The mobility shall have an actual duration of 21 days, excluding travel days, and must be completed by 31 May 2026. The exact mobility period must be agreed upon with Università Politecnica delle Marche. Deadline: 18 marzo 2026 alle ore 12:00 (CET).
